ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) to high-intensity (white) pixels. High contrast thresholds are present at the boundaries of the distal patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region. Large, irregularly shaped high-intensity white patches are localized on the distal regions of both lobes. The left lobe patch is more contiguous and occupies the upper-left quadrant. The right lobe patch is fragmented with dark pixel incursions. Small high-intensity circular clusters (speckling) are scattered across the lower central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; the vertex is well-defined and centered along the longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serrations. Edge profile shows a series of micro-peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 15 pixels in amplitude, most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight upward concavity near the distal tips, creating an overall S-curve profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, three-dimensional clusters of high-contrast, circular calcified structures (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips and sparsely along the leading edge. Several faint circular gray scars are visible in the central dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the lower central region and the left lobe's pigmentation transition zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the terminal tips of both lobes; visible rake marks in central pigmentation; minor irregular notches along the trailing edge suggests previous mechanical stress.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a significantly higher volume and density of barnacle colonization compared to the left, creating a unique asymmetrical topographical profile.
